_note: ⛔ SNG-449. IDEAL DISTRIBUTION BY EFFECT. Erik: 'a psionic (Mind) can be very physical — hitting with psychic blasts that do PHYSICAL damage, while some skills could be damaging the mind.' ⚠️ SO THE TARGET IS BUILT ON EFFECT, NOT ATTRIBUTE. The medium belongs to the tradition; the effect can be anything. Mind carries HARM 3 for exactly this reason.
_scale: 4 signature · 3 strong · 2 present · 1 floor. EVERY CELL >= 1 → 100% function coverage, all 14.
_controlRuling: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15: 'Bring CONTROL down by 1 per tradition-ish. Control should be a bit more RARE, while some traditions SPECIALIZE in it.' Column 44 → 31. Only DEMONIC keeps 4 — the named want and the struck term is what control IS for them. ⚠️ Body, Light, Life and Spirit drop to the floor: a Rootkin or a Numinous restricting someone should feel like a borrowed act.

Mind.sig: ⛔ CONTROL + PERCEIVE. A psionic reads and dominates. ⚠️ HARM AT 3 IS THE POINT ERIK MADE — a psychic blast does PHYSICAL damage; the medium is mental, the effect is not. MAKE at 1: thought builds nothing that stands.

Body.sig: DEFEND + MOVE + BOLSTER. ⚠️ Ki is endurance and placement before it is a strike.

Light.sig: ⛔ HARM + PERCEIVE — revelation as violence, and truth as an attack. CONCEAL AT 1 IS THE FLOOR AND SHOULD STAY 1: a Light tradition that hides well is a contradiction, but it must still be able to.

Dark.sig: ⛔ CONCEAL + PERCEIVE. Exact mirror of Light and deliberately so. RESTORE at 1 — the deeps do not mend.

Life.sig: ⛔ RESTORE + BOLSTER + MAKE. HARM AT 1 IS DELIBERATE — the floor exists so a Rootkin is not helpless, and nothing more.

Death.sig: ⛔ HARM + CONTROL + SOCIAL. ⚠️ SOCIAL AT 4 IS THE PATHOS SECT — grief shared is a social act with mechanical teeth. RESTORE at 1: they tend endings, they do not reverse them.

Angelic.sig: DEFEND + RESTORE + BOLSTER. ⚠️ Mercy administered — and CONTROL at 3, because administration is control.

Demonic.sig: ⛔ SOCIAL + CONTROL. The named want and the struck term. ⚠️ THIS IS WHERE THE MISSING CHARM SPACE BELONGS FIRST.

Breaking.sig: ⛔ HARM + CONTROL. The Edge and Ruinwork. MAKE at 1 is almost comic and should stay so.

Building.sig: ⛔ MAKE + DEFEND. ⚠️ CONTROL at 3 is Stillcraft — halting a conflict IS control, and it is the sect's whole craft.

Chaos.sig: ⛔ MOVE + CONTROL. Luck-riding is repositioning, and unmaking another's plan is control.

Order.sig: ⛔ MAKE + PERCEIVE + CONTROL + DEFEND — the widest signature on the chart, and correct: prediction, binding, arcologies, systems. ⚠️ The cost is MOVE 1 and CONCEAL 1.

Span.sig: ⛔ MOVE + PERCEIVE. Distance and duration — the far step, and the kept count.

Spirit.sig: ⛔ PERCEIVE + RESTORE + SOCIAL. ⚠️ Numenwork steadies a soul in crisis, which is restoration and social at once. Raised from 10 abilities to 27 — the most under-built tradition in the game.

subfunctions._finding: ⛔ THE SUBFUNCTION LAYER ALREADY EXISTS AND IS SOUND: `functions`, 24 distinct values across 948 uses. ⚠️ NOT `effectTags` — that is 266 distinct tags for 477 uses, free text rather than a taxonomy, and it carries heal/healing, precise/precision and reveal/perceive as separate tags. IT SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR ANYTHING STRUCTURAL.
subfunctions._theSubfunctionFindings:
⛔ PERCEIVE IS 191 USES AND `reveal` ALONE IS 145 — the single most common thing an ability does in this game is TELL YOU SOMETHING. That is the 2026-07-07 critique with a number on it.
⛔ SOCIAL IS **ZERO**. Not thin — ABSENT. There is no persuade, no bargain, no provoke, no soothe subfunction anywhere in 948 uses. ⚠️ Which is why the charm search returned nothing: the game has no social VERBS, only social-attributed abilities that do something else.
⚠️ CONCEAL IS 25, the thinnest real column, and 28 of 31 old traditions had none.
⛔ SIX SUBFUNCTIONS DO NOT ROLL UP AND FOUR OF THEM SHOULD BECOME CANON: `resist` 33 (belongs under DEFEND), `open` 23 (its own thing — locks, seals, passage), `transform` 20 and `summon` 16 (MAKE), `deceive` 19 (CONCEAL), `track` 15 (PERCEIVE).
